animation.notes: The Ulanzi TC002 running AWTRIX NG (1.2.2) has a 52x16 RGB matrix. The model is 52x17 on purpose: in the 3x5 face a 16-pixel panel has room for 2 text rows, one pixel short of 3, and FiestaBoard refuses an LED board below 3 x 10. The plugin renders 52x17 (3 rows x 13 columns) and drops the one-pixel gap between the second and third text row before it sends, so the device gets exactly 52x16; the preview keeps that gap. Each frame is one PUT /api/v1/apps/pushed/{name} with a native-size layout (TC002 only: a layout keeps all 52x16 pixels whatever enlargeApps says) whose one region draws a 52x16 base64 RGB888 bitmap. The docs say a pushed app that is on screen shows a replacement at once. maxFps 5 is a conservative starting point, not measured: a pushed app is replaced over HTTP in one request and the TC002 accepts bodies up to 2 MiB (one frame is about 3.4 KB). Pushed apps live in RAM only and vanish when the clock restarts; GET /api/v1/device reports uptimeSeconds, which the plugin watches to resend the page.
sources: https://github.com/Blueforcer/awtrix-ng/blob/main/docs/guides/pushed-apps.md (an app on screen shows a change at once)
https://github.com/Blueforcer/awtrix-ng/blob/main/docs/reference/limits.md (2 MiB request body on the TC002)
